leastWorthwhile.text: The final secured crossing was terse; I wanted to see how the rover and line actually crossed the soft patch.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the anchored line and gravel crossing came together as expected.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to reach the ice and learn what the intact band contains. This short crossing itself was straightforward rather than especially challenging.
